context: An elderly couple reminisces about culture and sports
purpose: Teach: オシム/水木/カズ/圓/聡/孝/淳/東ティモール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃のサッカー観戦、オシム氏の解説、楽しかった。
lines.en: Watching soccer when I was young — Osim's commentary was wonderful.
lines.style: Gentle, distant gaze inward. Slow pace, warm nostalgic breath. Settling into the memory as he speaks. Quiet, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 水木先生の漫画、子供たちが熱心に読んでたわね。
lines.en: The children read Mizuki-sensei's manga so eagerly, didn't they.
lines.style: Bright recollection, a small smile in the voice. Conversational, present-tense warmth. Slight lift on the memory itself, gentle downward curve at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: カズの試合、まだテレビで観られる、ありがたい。
lines.en: Kazu's matches — we can still watch them on TV. That's a blessing.
lines.style: Soft wonder beneath the surface. Slight pause before the final phrase, weight given to the gratitude. Slow, measured. A quiet amazement that good things persist.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 落語の圓師匠、晩年も精力的だったわね。
lines.en: Master En in rakugo — he was so full of life in his later years.
lines.style: Admiring, almost reverent tone. Unhurried pacing, letting the image settle. Gentle warmth, the respect of someone watching someone else live fully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 息子の名は聡。甥の孝、弟の淳、世代をつないでくれる。
lines.en: Our son Satoshi, our nephew Takashi, my brother Atsushi — they carry it forward.
lines.style: Deliberate naming, each one spoken with quiet pride. Steady cadence, weight on the inheritance of names and values. Tender undercurrent. Finality that feels like settling.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 海外ボランティアで、東ティモールに行った孫もいたわね。
lines.en: And we had a grandchild who went to East Timor as a volunteer.
lines.style: Wistful admiration, slow pace. Lingering on 'volunteer' with gentle pride. Voice softens toward the close, trailing with the satisfaction of witnessing generosity passed down.
